_create_yaml_config.description:
Tiny, self-contained test dataset used to exercise the full pipeline end-to-end
without depending on the real operational archive. The analysis/first-guess GRIB
input is generated by running a small ICON-NWP experiment (see `test_mode` below)
and emulating a short operational archive from its output.
Data is on the small icon-ch2 test grid with hourly granularity.
_create_yaml_config.name: varda-kenda-ch1-2km-2020-2020-1h-v1.0-pl13-test
